description: Assay decision-graph hooks. Parses <assay-decision> tags from agent transcripts and persists to the typed decision graph at ~/.assay/decisions.db.

hooks.command:
_C="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"; _E="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; _P=$({ [ -n "$_E" ] && printf '%s
' "$_E"; ls -dt "$_C/plugins/cache/assaylabs/assay"/[0-9]*/ 2>/dev/null; printf '%s
' "$_C/plugins/marketplaces/assaylabs/assay"; printf '%s
' "$_C/plugins/marketplaces/levievanshantz/assay"; } | while IFS= read -r _R; do _R="${_R%/}"; [ -f "$_R/plugin/scripts/stop-hook.mjs" ] && { printf '%s
' "$_R"; break; }; done); [ -n "$_P" ] || { echo '{"continue":true,"suppressOutput":true}'; exit 0; }; node "$_P/plugin/scripts/stop-hook.mjs" || true; echo '{"continue":true,"suppressOutput":true}'

Stop.description: Drain <assay-decision> tags from transcript and persist to ~/.assay/decisions.db. Lexicographic ordering (zz- prefix) ensures this fires after ECC's session-end and claude-mem's summarize hook.
